distance.title: Distance
distance.description: How far from the Entity should the follower be

target.title: Target Entity
target.description: The target entity where we are going to teleport

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: walkable = floor soldiers stand on; obstacle = blocks movement; coverLow / coverTall = blocks movement and is scored as cover; stair = invisible navigation ramp rising along local +Z; door = opening that must stay passable (checked on rebuild); defensiveArea = role destination slot (enemyDefend: radius = area the enemy squad holds); spawn = soldier spawn point (Slot id = soldier name, Team); threat = unused since milestone 3; decor = visual only (ignored by navigation)

blocksSight.title: Blocks sight
blocksSight.description: Used by line-of-sight checks (perception and cover).

slot.title: Slot id
slot.description: Defensive areas: role slot (stairApproach1/2, overwatch1/2, enemyDefend). Soldier spawn: soldier name (ECHO, FOXTROT...).

team.title: Team
team.description: Soldier spawn / defensive area: friendly or enemy.

holdSeconds.title: Match end: objective held with no enemy near (s)

speed.title: Move speed (m/s, NS bot cover run 3.2)

damageMul.title: Damage multiplier
damageMul.description: Extra multiplier on the tuned rifle damage (TacticalCombat.TUNING). 1 = documented TTK.
